CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS market_impact_cost_log (
    log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ordersmark TEXT,
    mic NUMERIC,
    calculated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_rec RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR v_rec IN
        SELECT 
            o."ORD_STAMP",
            ((o."order_attributes"->>'quantity')::NUMERIC) as qty,
            ((o."order_attributes"->>'limit_price')::NUMERIC) as lp,
            ((ai.indicator_bundle->'order_flow'->>'large_order_ratio')::NUMERIC) as lor
        FROM orders o
        JOIN marketdata md ON o."exchSpot" = md."EXCH_SPOT"
        LEFT JOIN analyticsindicators ai ON md."EXCH_SPOT" = ai."md_ref"
        WHERE o."order_attributes"->>'status' = 'New'
    LOOP
        INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
        VALUES (v_rec."ORD_STAMP", v_rec.qty * v_rec.lp * COALESCE(v_rec.lor, 0) * 0.01);
    END LOOP;
END;
$$;
